subject: Post-call: SignalCraft trial readiness & prompt upload plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Matthew Lee <matthew.lee@signalcraft.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: SignalCraft trial readiness & prompt upload plan

Matt — thanks for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the trial kickoff:

• Goal: Run a 3-week trial to validate Redwood inference latency, cost, and answer quality on your search-assist workload. Primary success metric: 95th percentile gen latency < 200ms at 8 RPS with batch sizing tuned; secondary: retrieval+generation F1 >= 0.78 on the labeled eval set.
• Data you will provide: prompt logs (customer queries), annotated correctness labels for ~2k seed examples, and a broader prompt inventory (~10k lines) across three domains (billing, product, support).
• Security/compliance: we'll run in Redwood Hosted sandbox with isolated project; we requested your signed NDA this morning (Monica to attach SOC2 summary and data handling doc).
• Ownership and timeline: you to upload prompt inventory and labels by Apr 26; Redwood to deliver a baseline eval report and tuned config by May 7; canary environment available by May 9. Monica will own compliance artifacts; Laura owns onboarding & S3 transfer.
• Upload mechanics: preferred is S3 path (pre-signed upload or we can give an SFTP alternative). We shared a prompt inventory template (CSV) — please use the columns: prompt_id, raw_prompt, domain, user_intent, anonymized_user_id, label (optional), notes.

Action items (owners + dates):
- Matthew: confirm S3 bucket or let us provision a pre-signed upload (due Apr 23)
- SignalCraft data ops: deliver prompt_inventory.csv and labels (due Apr 26)
- Monica (Redwood): send SOC2 summary + NDA confirmation (today)
- Laura (Redwood): share transfer instructions and upload checklist (today)

I attached the prompt inventory template for SignalCraft to use and the NDA we signed this morning. If the timeline above needs shifting, tell us which milestones to move.

Thanks — looking forward to getting data flowing so we can start evaluations.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Matthew Lee <matthew.lee@signalcraft.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@signalcraft.com
Date: 2028-04-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: SignalCraft trial readiness & prompt upload plan

Karthik — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few items from my side:

1) We can provide the prompt inventory and the 2k annotated labels; the full 10k anonymous prompt dump may take until Apr 28 due to an internal cleanup step. Is Apr 28 acceptable?
2) We need clarification on PII: some prompts include account numbers and partial emails. Our data ops would prefer guidance on acceptable anonymization patterns (we can hash user ids and redact emails).
3) S3: we prefer to push to our corp S3 and provide a pre-signed URL for Redwood to pull. I can loop in procurement if we need a cross-account role.

I'll upload the signed SignalCraft NDA to your shared drive later today (CC'd procurement). Also copying my data ops lead (procurement@signalcraft.com) for visibility.

— Matt
Matthew Lee
Head of Product | SignalCraft
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Matthew Lee <matthew.lee@signalcraft.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-22T13:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: SignalCraft trial readiness & prompt upload plan

Matt — Apr 28 is OK. Couple clarifications and some concrete acceptance criteria so your team can validate before upload:

Anonymization guidance:
- Hash any user identifiers with SHA256 or replace with consistent pseudonyms (user_0001).
- Remove direct emails and account numbers; replace with [REDACTED_ACCOUNT] or similar tokens.
- Keep domain labels (billing/product/support) intact.

Prompt inventory expectations (use the attached CSV template):
- Minimum: 10k rows preferred, 3 domains evenly represented if possible.
- Seed eval set: include at least 2k labeled rows with binary correctness labels and a short rationale column where possible. These will be used for automated pass/fail scoring.

Evaluation plan highlights:
- Baseline run: Redwood will run models A/B (open-llama-70B-quant and rwin-13B-int8) against the seed eval set and compute recall/F1 and human-like rating distributions.
- Acceptance thresholds (example): exact match >= 0.62 OR F1 >= 0.78 on the labeled seed; human review pass rate >= 75% for top-3 responses on a stratified sample of 300 prompts.
- Latency/cost targets: 95th pctl latency <200ms at 8 RPS; target token-cost per Q&A to be below $0.015 (estimated).

Ownership & timeline (updated):
- Apr 23: you confirm S3 method (pre-signed URL or cross-account role).
- Apr 26: deliver labeled seed (2k) + initial inventory subset (2k) so we can begin baseline runs earlier.
- Apr 28: full inventory (10k) and any additional labels.
- May 7: baseline report + recommended model/config for the canary.

Laura — can you circulate S3 transfer steps and a short checklist for their data ops? Monica — please attach SOC2 summary and any redaction checklist we send to customers.

If that all sounds good I'll mark the timeline in the deal record and schedule the data-handoff call for Apr 24 (15min) to walk through the CSV template.

— Karthik
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Matthew Lee <matthew.lee@signalcraft.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-22T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: SignalCraft trial readiness & prompt upload plan

Matt — attaching the SOC2 summary and our standard data handling overview (see attachment stub: SOC2_summary_redwood.pdf). A couple compliance notes for your data ops:

• We do not require full production data. Seed and inventory can be sanitized as described by Karthik.
• For any fields you cannot hash client-side, we can run an in-transit redaction in a dedicated staging bucket — but that requires a short security review (24–48 hours).
• Please include a short data retention note in your upload metadata if you require specific handling (we'll honor deletion requests tied to the trial).

I've also attached the signed NDA we exchanged this morning (attachment stub: ndasignalcraft_signed.pdf). Laura — I'll let you coordinate transfer instructions.

Best,
Monica Patel
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
From: Matthew Lee <matthew.lee@signalcraft.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-25T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: SignalCraft trial readiness & prompt upload plan

Thanks all — we're aligned. Quick status update from SignalCraft ops:

• Confirmed: we'll provide a pre-signed S3 URL (you will receive the first batch of 2k labeled rows by EOD Apr 26).
• Anonymization: we'll hash user ids client-side and redact emails per Karthik's guidance.
• Procurement: PDF of the internal transfer forms uploaded to your shared drive link.

We'll join the Apr 24 sync if needed, but our ops lead suggested we proceed with the upload and let Redwood start the baseline runs as soon as the first batch arrives. Looking forward to the report on May 7.

— Matt
